name: Talebearer
overview: Scripture warns strongly against the behavior of a talebearer, one who spreads harmful reports or secrets among people, as seen in Leviticus 19:16 where God commands not to act as a talebearer among the community. The example of Joseph in Genesis 37:2 illustrates how bringing evil reports can cause strife within families. The Psalms emphasize the character of one who dwells with the Lord, highlighting that such a person refrains from backbiting and taking up reproach against neighbors (Psalms 15:3). Proverbs 11:13 contrasts the talebearer who reveals secrets with the faithful person who conceals matters, underscoring the value of trustworthiness and integrity in speech.
